tests.title: RPT-01 preserves authorized sources, exports 25 real projects and reopens before following the current source
critical_assertions: Real Workbench and Reports form select Budget Overview, Portfolio Dashboard and Hot Topics & Actions; actual review-agenda returns Budget, Projects and empty Hot Topics.
Exact 25 project identities and names, annual/monthly periods, forecast 1320 and January 110; explicit UI reordering preserves Projects, Budget, Hot Topics and exact selected IDs/counts/content.
Real OPEX edit previews January 110 to 190; source stays unchanged until Confirm and apply, then source becomes annual 1400 while the preserved review remains exactly equal.
DOCX and PPTX are generated from the preserved review and downloaded through same-origin private artifact URLs; distinct artifacts and hashes.
OOXML extraction checks every captured value/period/source tuple in order, 25 unique project records, all long-note content including tail, empty topic, captured 1320 and exclusion of current 1400.
Meeting opens and reloads its durable URL, navigates preserved topics, and retains 1320/110; following its captured source reaches current Budget Overview at 1400 with the same reporting year.

tests.title: RPT-02 confirms and reuses the exact human answer under C05, then rejects its edited version
critical_assertions: Ask and reply through actual Review controls with authoritative recipient, captured source basis and exact reviewRef/reviewVersion/reviewDigest/sectionId pin; validate real request, idempotency header/body and CAS version.
New reply remains unconfirmed (400 answer-unconfirmed); old messages remain intact and the appended reply has its own incarnation.
Review this answer uses the exact message id/incarnation/version; inspect full server projection and pin in visible details, equal to the preserved 1320 capture after the source changed to 1400.
Confirm this answer submits the inspected observation, source version and fingerprint without a new preparation; exact receipt and readback preserve answer text, author and pin.
Reload reopens the same review/thread and automatically reuses the exact confirmed answer; storage version remains unchanged, so reuse creates no confirmation write.

Save answer edit advances only message version within the same incarnation; current body is visible, old selector returns 409 answer-selection-changed and old reuse returns 503 answer-reuse-unavailable.

Read original answer uses the exact historical id/incarnation/version under current authorization; original body, basis and pin remain intact while the edited body remains current; preserved review remains equal with 1320.

tests.title: RPT-03 removes one authorized record without editing its source and creates only an explicit new revision
critical_assertions: Remove exactly one opaque record reference issued by the actual authorized selector; do not infer a record from page-level evidence or fabricate reference encoding.
Selection changes from 25 unique project references to the exact remaining 24; one project identity disappears and every retained value/period tuple remains identical.
Business source projects, owners, entries and hot topics remain exactly equal before and after selection removal.
Changing the real January source to 190 does not mutate the existing preserved review at annual 1320.
Prepare current data as a new revision and Preserve this review are separate explicit actions; new selection has 24 records and annual 1400.

Preserve request names previousReviewRef and the exact new selection; successor has a different id, links its predecessor, preserves order/counts, reads at 1400, and predecessor remains exactly unchanged at 1320.

tests.title: RPT-04 revokes the real session and clears cached meeting data, export and answer access
critical_assertions: Create a real review, private DOCX and C05-confirmed answer; retain the authentic old credential only in memory in a separate browser context.
Actual Sign out returns 204/no-store and navigates the original page to the real login route, removing meeting and discussion.
Retained page attempts guarded navigation after logout and must clear the entire meeting/discussion/confirmed-answer/navigation DOM and cached private content.
Old credential receives exact 303 login redirects for review/artifact GET and 403 for answer read and export POST; all responses are no-store and leak none of the asserted private markers.
Fresh real single-use enrollment admits a new session for the same local operator; saved review and answer are readable and the same private DOCX downloads with the exact prior SHA-256.
After fresh admission, old credential remains denied for review, artifact and answer; no broadening of grants or credential fabrication.

privacy.reason: Real operator credentials may otherwise be retained in Playwright API/network recordings.
privacy.credential_handling: Actual local enrollment and scoped cookies; old storage state stays in memory. Private runtime files stay outside the Playwright artifact tree and are removed by the owned lifecycle.
privacy.evidence_scope: Explicit synthetic-business-content receipts and private downloaded reports only; no tokens, cookies, enrollment codes, storageState files, databases or private installation directories.

implementation_constraints.revocation_assertion_change: Removal of the entire navigation and private view replaces the prior disabled-control representation; all denied HTTP, content-clearing, fresh-admission and old-credential assertions remain.

title_audit.explanation: The shared adapter drops the discovery-only UI title. createReviewAgendaSelection supplies canonical dashboardTopics titles. Existing E2E title assertions are unchanged.
title_audit.bootstrap_dependency: Shared patch postimage assigns id=report:<page> for Reports entries because discover otherwise returns id=dashboard for every topic. The adapter preserves topic, selectionRef, recordRefs and period; review-update preserves each prior section.id. Patch is inert and awaits session23.

limits: All four nominal journeys are NOT_RUN. Static source inspection is not installed journey evidence; no S, run or job is assigned here.
The available real local identity selects the same operator as recipient. Distinct-recipient authority is NOT_PROVEN; no alternative principal or grant is fabricated.
Logout proves the intended durable local session boundary only when executed. Selective Talent revocation remains NOT_PROVEN.
OOXML assertions are semantic extraction and completeness checks. Visual clipping, rendered layout and native application execution remain NOT_PROVEN.
Uncovered canonical criteria and runtime proof obligations remain in CRITERIA.json; no criterion is passed by this implementation receipt.
